hints.Einstein: Mess up your hair, stick out your tongue, write on a board, and point to your head.
hints.Messi: Dribble fast with small steps, dodge people, score with a left foot, and point up at the sky.
hints.Michael Jackson: Do a moonwalk, grab your hat, spin, and wear one sparkly glove.
hints.Charlie Chaplin: Waddle with feet turned out, twirl a cane, tip a small bowler hat, and twitch a little mustache.
hints.Elvis Presley: Curl your lip, swivel your hips, strum a guitar, and slick your hair back.
hints.Cristiano Ronaldo: Stand with feet wide apart, jump high, score, then spin and land with your arms spread wide in celebration.
hints.Napoleon: Put one hand in your jacket, stand in a proud stance, and give a loud command.
hints.Mozart: Powder a wig, play fast piano keys, then conduct with a flourish.
hints.Shakespeare: Write with a feather pen, hold a skull, and strike a dramatic pose with one hand on your chest.
hints.Leonardo da Vinci: Paint with a thin brush, sketch a flying machine, and smile faintly.
hints.Mahatma Gandhi: Walk with a staff, wear simple robes, sit and spin thread, and stay calm.
hints.Michael Jordan: Run, leap with your tongue out, dunk a ball, and hang in the air.
hints.Muhammad Ali: Float like a butterfly with light feet, jab quickly, and boast with a big grin.
hints.Rumi: Spin in slow circles with one palm up and one down, and stare toward the sky.
hints.Marilyn Monroe: Hold down a billowing dress, pout, and blow a kiss with a breathy wink.
hints.Bruce Lee: Make fast kicks and punches, rub your thumb over your nose, and let out a battle cry.
hints.Freddie Mercury: Pump a fist, hold a half microphone stand, strut with a big mustache, and pose for a roaring crowd.
hints.Picasso: Paint a face with both eyes on the same side, then tilt your head to look at it.
hints.Beethoven: Play wild piano, cup your ear at nothing, and scowl with wild hair.
hints.Cleopatra: Draw heavy eyeliner, pose in profile, and have a servant fan you.
hints.Nikola Tesla: Hold a glowing ball, make sparks with your fingers, and shake as lightning hits you.
hints.Frida Kahlo: Paint a self-portrait with a unibrow, wear flowers in your hair, and look serious.
hints.Isaac Newton: Sit under a tree, get hit on the head by something, and look up amazed.
hints.Marie Curie: Peer at glowing glass tubes in a lab, then hold your fingers up to see them shine.
hints.Steve Jobs: Walk on stage in a turtleneck, hold up a small thing, then raise one finger as if adding "one more thing".
hints.Nelson Mandela: Raise a fist in a cell, walk free, and wave to a joyful crowd.
hints.Salvador Dalí: Twirl a long thin mustache upward, melt a clock over your arm, and stare wildly.
hints.Mother Teresa: Wrap a cloth over your head, hold hands with sick people, and care for them gently.
hints.Bob Marley: Shake long dreadlocks, strum a guitar slowly, sway with a smile, and puff on something.
hints.Abraham Lincoln: Put on a tall hat, stroke a beard with no mustache, and stand very tall.
hints.Usain Bolt: Crouch at a starting line, burst out running at full speed, then strike a lightning-bolt pose with one arm pointing up.
hints.Barack Obama: Stride up to a podium, point at a cheering crowd with a broad smile, and wave warmly.
hints.Queen Elizabeth II: Stand upright with a handbag on your arm, give a small gentle wave with a stiff wrist, and nod politely.
hints.Pelé: Leap and kick an imaginary ball backward over your head in a bicycle kick, then pump a fist with a big smile.
